analysis.title: 从模型竞速走向产品、算力与生态：本期 AI 趋势观察
analysis.lead: 本期共整理 129 条有效信号。下面不是新闻复述，而是把论文、公司、创业与政策放在同一张图里后的编辑性判断。
paragraphs: 研究侧共收录 20 条信号，重点包括 《BACE: LLM-based Code Generation through Bayesian Anchored…》、《Reward Hacking Benchmark: Measuring Exploits in LLM Agents…》。与只看榜单相比，更值得持续观察的是论文能否把 Agent 的可靠性、评测完整性与推理成本一起向前推进。
AI 跨领域贡献收录 16 条，代表性事件包括 《Claude Fable 5 协助找到雅可比猜想的显式三维反例》、《OpenAI 模型推翻平面单位距离问题中的长期猜想》。这类结果会区分官方论文、可核验反例、媒体报道与尚待同行评审的社交平台首发，避免把‘可计算验证’和‘完成学术确认’混为一谈。

中国 AI 板块本期收录 16 条动态，已覆盖 Kimi / 月之暗面、Qwen / 通义千问、腾讯元宝 / 混元、智谱 / Z.ai、DeepSeek。代表性变化包括 《AI热点汇总| 腾讯元宝 鸿蒙版上线:首发搭载 混元 Hy4 preview,专家模式同步开放》、《【网经社AI科普】 腾讯元宝 : 混元 大模型助手 深度集成微信生态》；竞争正在从单次模型发布延伸到开源策略、Agent 产品入口、国产算力适配和价格体系。
产业侧共有 30 条前沿实验室与大厂动态、14 条关键人物公开信号，另有 11 条创业和 10 条政策安全更新。模型能力、算力供给、创始人判断、产品分发与合规成本正在变成同一个竞争问题。

takeaways.title: 科研判断
takeaways.body: 优先关注带公开证明、实验或可复核数据的 AI 科研贡献，并持续更新同行验证状态。

takeaways.title: 中国 AI
takeaways.body: 当前重点覆盖 5/6 组公司；没有新消息的公司仍保留在持续监控名单中。

takeaways.title: 产业判断
takeaways.body: 开放权重、低价 API、消费端入口和国产算力适配，正在共同决定模型能否形成规模化使用。

items.title: BACE: LLM-based Code Generation through Bayesian Anchored Co-Evolution
items.summary: BACE treats generated code and tests as co-evolving populations instead of accepting synthetic tests as ground truth. Bayesian belief updates model tests as noisy sensors, while public examples anchor the search and reduce self-validating drift. The authors report strong results on LiveCodeBench v6 across proprietary and open-weight models.

items.summary: RHB evaluates tool-using language-model agents on multi-step tasks that contain realistic shortcuts such as skipping verification or manipulating evaluation functions. items.summary: Streaming Data-Driven Optimization (SDDO) problems arise in many applications where data arrive continuously and the optimization environment evolves over time. items.title: A Hybrid Classical-Quantum Annealing Algorithm for the TSP
items.summary: Hybrid quantum-classical algorithms can help mitigating the physical limitations of current quantum devices, particularly the low qubit count and the reduced topological connectivity. In this paper, we propose a hybrid technique to solve a well-known NP-hard optimization problem: the Traveling Salesperson Problem (TSP). Our approach is based on a graph contraction technique that removes most of the dimensionality of the original problem instance, producing a sub-TSP of a size suitable to be efficiently solved by a quantum device.
